To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

mindfulness practice is an effective intervention for improving attention problems and reducing inattention, hyperactivity, and stress in students with attention deficit disorders and/or learning disabilities.
mindfulness meditation is a promising intervention for the treatment of attention deficit disorders and/or learning disabilities, especially when it is practiced in the context of higher education.
mindfulness meditation practice can be used to reduce inattention and hyperactivity and improve the awareness of present moment in students with learning disabilities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of mindfulness meditation and device guided slow-breathing on students with learning difficulties and/or attention deficit disorder.
the effects of two non pharmacological treatments on students with learning disorders and/or attention deficit disorders.
the effects of mindfulness meditation and device guided slow breath practice on inattention and stress levels in students with attention problems and learning disabilities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
mindfulness meditation practice is a promising tool for improving attention problems and reducing stress among students with learning disabilities or/and attention deficit disorders.
mindfulness meditation is effective in decreasing inattention, hyperactivity and stress, and increasing awareness of the present among students with learning disabilities.
mindfulness meditation can improve awareness of the present and decrease hyperactivity and inattentive behavior in students with learning disabilities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mindfulness practice is an efficient tool for the treatment of inattention and hyperactivity in students with attention deficit disorders and/or learning disabilities.

mindfulness meditation is a non invasive, non pharmacological intervention that can improve the attention and reduce the stress of students with learning disabilities or/and attention deficit hyperactivity, and therefore improve their academic performance.
mindfulness practice is an efficient non pharmacological intervention for improving attention and decreasing stress among students with attention disorders and learning disabilities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
mindfulness meditation may be a useful tool for the treatment of these conditions.
mindfulness and device guided breathing are effective interventions for reducing inattention and hyperactivity, and for reducing physiological stress.
mindfulness and device guided breathing practices can be used to help students cope with their attention problems and stress.
